Definition: properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival
BiblicalUsage: Kece means the full moon, the time appointed. Psalms 81:3 says blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day, and Proverbs 7:20 says the goodman will come home at the day appointed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's calendar runs on appointed times, and he is never late to his own feast.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
